scope: Complete paired JCT, all tasks retained; descriptive partition, not causal savings.

h2d_sources.semantics: predictive is JOIN/tool anticipation; execution_handoff is submitted demand before first service; unknown_controlled is tagged payload without a known source; native is the untagged receipt remainder. Actual lead and reuse require separate evidence. Bytes and pool units partition each batch; mixed-batch category counts can overlap.

semantics: Positive saved_seconds means native minus predictive; no divergent or slow task is removed.
Root JOIN/LLM/tool/other intervals partition client workflow time exactly. JOIN has precedence over overlapping task-tool callbacks; root LLM has precedence over other tools.
last_child_* decomposes root_join_wait; never add it again to the root partition. The last returning member is identified retrospectively, not an online feature or counterfactual.
LLM spans are client submit through result: ingress, queue, GPU service, interleaving and delivery. They are not pure GPU service and do not isolate admission benefit.

Optional LLM subpartitions use native queue registration and the first completed prefill's recorded run_batch entry, not CUDA launch. After-first-service time still includes interleaving, remaining prefill/decode and result delivery. Missing or non-ordered service anchors retain the entire request as unmeasured.
Other contains client setup, callbacks, internal invocations and unclassified/nested waits. A difference is not isolated removable overhead.
All-agent sums overlap across siblings and are not additive workflow JCT.
Output-based groups are post-treatment descriptions, not trajectory-matched causal cohorts.
Completed workflows are not independently graded successful solutions. Different realized work, shared-resource interference and different policy prevent isolated causal attribution.
